steps.title: Where are you in your career right now?
steps.why: So we only recommend what fits your stage.

options.label: Just starting out
options.hint: First job, or under two years in the field
options.reaction: Early is a great time to build the right habits — we'll point you to the best starting place.

options.label: Mid-level, doing more than my title
options.hint: I deliver, but the title and pay don't follow
options.reaction: That gap is exactly what this program is built for.

options.label: Senior, aiming for the next step
options.hint: Staff, principal, or a role abroad
options.reaction: Great baseline — now it's about the details that set you apart.

options.label: Leading people or architecture
options.hint: And I want a wider reach
options.reaction: Leadership changes what 'impact' means — good place to sharpen it.

steps.title: What does your work do for the business?
steps.why: How you explain your work shapes how others value it.

options.label: I can explain it in numbers
options.reaction: Rare and valuable — we'll make sure it shows up everywhere it counts.

options.label: I know the impact, but freeze explaining it
options.hint: It's clear in my head, not out loud

options.label: I know what it does, not why it matters
options.hint: I can describe the system, not its value
options.reaction: This is the most common pattern we see, and the most fixable one.

options.label: I've never really thought about it
options.reaction: Honest answer — and the best possible starting point.

steps.title: When did someone above you last notice your impact?
steps.why: Being good and being seen are different problems.

options.label: It's recognized and cited
options.hint: My manager brings it up without me asking
options.reaction: Excellent — let's turn that recognition into leverage.

options.label: Only when something breaks
options.hint: I'm visible when I put out fires
options.reaction: The firefighter trap — valuable to everyone, promoted by no one. Fixable.

options.label: My team knows, my manager doesn't
options.hint: Peers rely on me; it doesn't travel upward
options.reaction: That's a story problem, not a skill problem.

options.label: Honestly, I don't know if anyone sees it
options.reaction: You're far from alone. Naming it is the first step.

steps.title: What actually holds you back?
steps.why: The real blocker is rarely technical.

options.label: Fear of losing stability
options.hint: What I built feels risky to leave
options.reaction: Reasonable fear — we plan moves that don't bet everything.

options.label: Interviews
options.hint: I freeze explaining what I know
options.reaction: Interviews are a skill of their own, and they can be practiced.

options.label: I'm the one who fixes everything
options.hint: Hard to delegate, hard to step back
options.reaction: Being indispensable is a trap. We'll work on getting out of it.

options.label: I'm running on empty
options.hint: Questioning whether I can do it
options.reaction: Thanks for saying it. Pace matters as much as the plan.

steps.title: What would change if you got there?
steps.why: Optional — but it's the answer we read first.
steps.placeholder: Title, money, role, country, time back…

steps.title: Where should we send your result?
steps.why: We'll email your profile summary and next step. Nothing else.

education.problem: Promotions are rarely decided by who writes the best code. They're decided by who can translate delivery into business impact — and most strong engineers were never taught to.
education.solution: We dig into your real deliveries and turn them into impact stories your manager, a recruiter or a hiring panel can repeat.

routes.title: Let's talk
routes.body: Your profile is exactly who this program is for. Pick a 30-minute intro call — we'll already know your context.

routes.title: Start with the guide
routes.body: You're in a strong position. The free guide covers the next moves at your stage — we'll check in after.

routes.title: Not the right fit — yet
routes.body: This program works best with a few years of delivery to build on. Here's a resource that fits where you are now.

readback.text: You're delivering above your title, and the gap is the story, not the skill.
You have real delivery to build on — the next step is making it visible.
You're early in the journey — the best investment now is depth in your craft.
